summary.text: Nancy Nathanson is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 13 who took office in 2007 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Jonathan Abrahamsen as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Nathanson was born in Dallas, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree in urban geography from the University of Oregon in 1975.
She has worked as a librarian, tap dance instructor and owner of Photoscapes, and as a supervisor and program manager at the University of Oregon Knight Library and Orbis Cascade Alliance.
She served on the Eugene City Council, including as council president, from 1993 to 2004 and has held several offices in the Lane County Democratic Party.
Nathanson assumed office in 2007 and defeated Kathy Cantrell-Damewood in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Revenue Committee and co-chair of the Joint Information Management and Technology Committee and the Joint Tax Expenditures Committee.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Nathanson said her campaign focuses on access to health care, affordability, homelessness, child care, safe communities and the economy.
She said she was chief sponsor of legislation used to stop the corporate takeover of a hospital emergency department.
